A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ParaBlock, with corresponding methods, experiments, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C. The available material supports reliable comparison despite reformatting and renumbering.

before.justification: Section 6 and Appendix A report original fine-tuning results, runtime and memory measurements, and ablation experiments.

after.justification: The original empirical results remain, with additional heterogeneous-delay results and a FedBuff comparison in Section 6.3.

M1.justification: Algorithm 2 corrects its final synchronization: after rounds 0 through T−1, v1 sends update Δ_T and outputs θ_{T+1}, whereas v2 sends Δ_{T−1} and outputs θ_T. This fixes the documented terminal step; the parallel computation, communication, and correction mechanism remains unchanged.

E1.justification: The datasets, tasks, and appendix multilingual coverage remain unchanged. Section 6.3 adds heterogeneous client-delay scenarios, extending v1's uniform staleness tests to environments where clients experience different delays.

E2.justification: Section 6.3 newly evaluates FedBuff on Llama 3-8B mathematical reasoning. Existing comparator sets remain; Full FT becoming Fed full FT and the appendix memory-table label FedLoRA becoming FedIT are relabelings.

E3.justification: New experiments specify one client with three-round staleness while others retain one-round staleness, and a FedBuff setting with two extremely delayed clients out of ten. Existing data partitions, model configurations, training budgets, and evaluation metrics remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The new heterogeneous-bandwidth experiment tests ParaBlock's robustness when one client is substantially slower than the others. Earlier block-partition, scheduling, data-heterogeneity, uniform-staleness, partial-participation, and compression analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Section 6.1 newly specifies random seed 42 for all libraries. This is additional seed disclosure, not evidence of more runs. No new repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests are reported; Figure 2's shaded bands are retained.

E6.justification: New Table 8 reports GSM8K 52.46 at 20.16 minutes for heterogeneous bandwidth and 55.88 at 38.72 minutes for its homogeneous reference. Section 6.3 adds FedBuff's score of 52.24. Matched existing tables and Figure 2 retain their results; these additions do not establish cross-version performance gains.

T1.justification: Theorem 5.3 and Appendices B.2/C.2 revise higher-order dependence on local steps K and heterogeneity coefficients, align iteration indices, and correct local learning-rate notation. Assumptions and the stated O(1/√T) rate remain unchanged. Lemma C.2's displayed statement still retains old powers despite its revised proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same central claims: overlapping communication and computation reduces runtime while preserving the convergence rate and comparable downstream performance.

C2.justification: Section 4 newly explains that keeping data local does not prevent sensitive model outputs and positions additional privacy techniques as complementary. Section 6.3 acknowledges degradation from slow clients, attributes the FedBuff result to delays, and identifies further redesign as future work.

D1.justification: A new Section 6.2 footnote discloses that bandwidth conditions are simulated, clarifying existing experiments without establishing a protocol change. Section 6.1 adds a promise of later code release, but supplies no repository. Hardware, optimizer settings, and appendix learning-rate information are retained.

R1.justification: V2 adds Nguyen et al. (2022), the FedBuff reference, and distinguishes ParaBlock's within-client overlap from asynchronous federated aggregation. The existing related-work coverage and broader positioning remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized grammar and terminology corrections, clarifies baseline labels, adds acknowledgments and discussion paragraphs, and changes citation style. The narrative organization of Sections 1–7 and Appendices A–C is retained.

P2.justification: The TMLR template changes typography, title and author layout, running headers, and float placement. V2 adds Table 8, redraws Figure 1 with continuation marks, and revises Table 7's caption to identify the cross-silo experiment. Figure 2 and existing table structures are substantially retained.

improvement.justification: Corrected terminal indexing and algebraic terms, clearer privacy qualifications, simulation and seed disclosures, and new slow-client evidence provide limited gains in clarity and reliability. Main empirical results remain unchanged. The gains are tempered by incompletely specified comparison conditions for FedBuff and the remaining mismatch between Lemma C.2's statement and its revised proof.
